requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the classes A1 through A4, B and C are included. Area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), and proximity to public transport are not energy requirements and were not translated into filters.
User wants the building located near public transport. Set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.
The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold for that capacity was provided. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are ignored.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table for office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili', the canonical filterable column for the requested typology) with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, education >= 75, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance ascending. The requirement's tipologia_bene_immobile is not a filterable column, so it was mapped to property_type, which carries the same allowed value.
